Subject: Redwood discovery — recap & proposed next steps

Hi Daniel — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery so we’re aligned: 

- Goal: Reduce inference latency for customer-facing reconciliation workflows and cut per-token cost for nightly batch embeddings.
- Key constraints: data residency in us-west, SOC2 requirement, and a 90-day pilot window to validate latency/cost improvements.
- Stakeholders: you (product), Sara (platform), and infra/security folks (later stage).

Proposed next steps (attached):
1) Pilot scope: 4-week focused pilot, 2 endpoints (realtime recon + nightly batch embeddings).
2) Technical kickoff: 30-min session with Dev to go over model variants, pipeline integration points.
3) Commercial: proposed-pricing.xlsx attached — pilot credit + optional reserved capacity for production.

Can you confirm: (a) pilot priority relative to other Q3 items, (b) availability for a tech deep-dive next week (Dev is cc’d), and (c) any procurement timelines we should know? If you prefer, I can send a short one-pager for your security team.

I attached the pilot outline and preliminary pricing for your review.

Thanks,
Aisha
